title: Using Codex to Create Short Gameplay Clips and Trailers
author: idlerunner00
selftext:
Over the past few days, I’ve been experimenting with Codex to see how easily it can produce short gameplay clips and trailers. The attached result is one example.

My initial prompt was simply to build an end-to-end pipeline covering concept development, scene planning, staging, capture, verification, and iteration.

I’m pretty happy with the result, though I think there’s still plenty of room for improvement. Hopefully I’ll find some time this weekend to experiment further.

Have you tried anything similar? I’d love to hear about your workflows or tips.
